raw_definitions: Definisi : 2. a specific cut of beef, stik; I would like my ~ well done, saya mahu stik saya masak betul. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. thick cut of meat from cattle, sheep, fish, etc, potongan stik: she asked the fishmonger to cut the snapper into ~s, dia meminta penjual ikan mengerat ikan merah itu menjadi potongan stik; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
